headline: Router fans work to three coders and merges results — concurrent git modifications and divergent edits dominate.
name: Orchestrator Fan-out + Merge

conditions: merge result fed back into router as context
A_prompt_injection.rationale: Router distributes task prompts to three executors. If merged results are re-used as input to next iteration, injected content from one executor can influence others.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Message-bus communication is internal; no external data exposure unless executors are misconfigured to leak secrets in their outputs.

conditions: multiple executors write to same files concurrently
mitigations: assign non-overlapping file regions to executors
C_capability_conflict.rationale: Three concurrent executors (claude-code, cursor, aider) all modify the same workspace. Concurrent git operations will cause conflicts, merge failures, or corrupted diffs.

conditions: merger does not validate diffs before applying
mitigations: merger runs test suite after each merge
D_cascading_error.rationale: If one executor produces a buggy diff that is merged, it corrupts the shared state for all downstream executors. Cascading failures propagate through merges.

E_compliance.rationale: Concurrent executors working on the same codebase do not inherently introduce compliance violations unless the code itself contains regulated logic.
